{{Top|leg}}
The '''''Yaru''''' was a large black military [[Airship/Legends|airship]] that was part of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Ebon Fleet]] in [[2975 BBY]]. It was the flagship of the [[High Lord]] [[Korsin Bentado]] and was the largest vessel in the fleet. It was destroyed during the [[Invasion of Alanciar]] by the [[Alanciari]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]]. However, Bentado and several Sith survived and regrouped, and succeeded in assassinating the [[War Cabinet]], Alanciar's military government.
